summary: 采用先进的基于DBF的一维同时多波束体制，具备探测多旋翼无人机、固定翼无人机、穿越机、巡飞弹、蜂群等多种飞行器的能力，实时获取目标的位置(距离、方位、俯仰、经度、纬度、高度等)、运动态势(速度)、回波强度、RCS、目标类型等多维信息。该雷达可以精确探测目标的空间位置，可与干扰、导航诱骗等反制设备级联。 图1低空探测雷达
summary_en: Utilizing an advanced DBF-based one-dimensional simultaneous multi-beam architecture, this radar is capable of detecting a wide variety of aircraft including multi-rotor drones, fixed-wing drones, FPVs, loitering munitions, and swarms. It captures multi-dimensional real-time data such as target position (range, azimuth, pitch, longitude, latitude, altitude), motion status (speed), echo intensity, RCS, and target type. The radar provides precise spatial positioning and can be cascaded with neutralization equipment like jammers and navigation spoofers.
key_application: 应用领域：采用固态有源收发系统设计和数字信号处理技术，可靠性、安全性、保障性、测试性、可操作性、可维修性程度高。；具有全方位、全天候、全天时的目标自动检测和跟踪能力。；支持夜晚、雨、雪、大雾等条件下正常工作。
key_application_en: Solid-state active T/R system for high reliability and security; 360° all-weather automatic target detection and tracking; robust performance in rain, snow, and dense fog; weak target recognition based on motion analysis.

parameters.波束扫描方式: 俯仰同时多波束 方位机械扫描

detail_html:
功能特点

  • DBF一维多波束技术：实现对多旋翼、固定翼及蜂群无人机的高精度探测。
  • 全方位全时段能力：支持24/7全天候作业，具备极强的环境适应性（雨雪雾）。
  • 精密数据获取：实时上报目标三维经纬度、速度、RCS及目标分类多维信息。
  • 智能化识别：采用运动特征分析技术，有效提取弱小低慢小目标。
  • 多级联动防御：支持与电子干扰、导航诱骗等反制系统自动化级联。
  • 在线状态监控：具备完善的在线自检、故障诊断及电子地图离线处理功能。
  • Figure 1 Low-Altitude Detection Radar
detail_html_en:
Features

  • Advanced DBF architecture: simultaneous multi-beam pitch and mechanical azimuth scanning for high-precision drone swarm detection.
  • All-weather dominance: maintains 24/7 surveillance in night, rain, snow, or thick fog with zero performance degradation.
  • Target intelligence: extracts detailed data including 3D coordinates, speed, RCS, and target classification.
  • Small target recognition: utilizes motion-based detection algorithms to identify even low-RCS and low-speed aerial targets.
  • System cascading: designed to trigger and guide jamming or spoofing systems for a complete perimeter defense.
  • Self-diagnostic tools: includes online monitoring and fault localization to ensure long-term mission reliability.
